author: science_audit
purpose: Define the smallest fixed one-factor E1 seed-11 artificial-momentum-diffusion comparison and one representative second-derivative feasibility pilot. Establish implementation/precision/cost evidence before any positive-viscosity accuracy is inspected.

authority.all_new_experiment_choices: Proposed, unexecuted and subject to a later explicit root selection/release before implementation/pilot/full execution. No implicit release follows from this file.

basis.coefficient_support: Both explicitly propose momentum residual r_q - nu_star*q_star_xstarxstar and an initial positive candidate nu_star=10^-3, leaving continuity unchanged. This plan fixes that single value; the prompt's pre-final pilot allowance is not used for coefficient search.
basis.actual_interfaces: losses.residuals accepts scaled coordinates (x/Lc,t/Tc) and returns conservative continuity/momentum residuals. ShallowWaterPINN.forward returns h*=softplus(z_h)+floor and q*=h*u*, while physical_state accepts SI coordinates. Smooth tanh/softplus and the product-defined q are retained.
basis.accepted_findings_context: Accepted core findings retain substantial wet/front errors and mixed fixed/adaptive outcomes; later friction findings retain substantial q/velocity/front error despite small global mass imbalance. These observations motivate measuring a tradeoff and do not establish that viscosity helps. No new study will claim improvement before its actual paired outputs.
basis.scientific_method_label: Project-specified constant artificial momentum diffusion. No claim of exact replication of an external method or of a known viscous analytical solution.

physics_and_scaling.definitions: x*=x/Lc, t*=t/Tc, h*=h/H, q*=q/(H Uc), with Tc=Lc/Uc and Uc=sqrt(gH).
physics_and_scaling.continuity: r_h = h*_(t*) + q*_(x*), unchanged in both branches.
physics_and_scaling.sign: r_q_nu=0 implies physical q_t + (q^2/h + g h^2/2)_x = nu*q_xx. Positive nu has the diffusion sign; adding +nu_star*q*_(x*x*) to the left residual would reverse it.
physics_and_scaling.dimensional_residual_relation: Physical momentum residual divided by H*Uc^2/Lc equals r_q - [nu/(Lc Uc)]q*_(x*x*). In particular q_xx=(H Uc/Lc^2)q*_(x*x*) and q_x=(H Uc/Lc)q*_(x*).
physics_and_scaling.derivative_contract: Differentiate q*=h*u*, including both factors, twice with respect to scaled x on the same owned requires_grad coordinate leaf. Do not differentiate raw velocity alone, omit h derivatives, introduce another affine map or apply SI chain factors a second time to already scaled derivatives.
physics_and_scaling.graph_contract: Preserve create_graph through both coordinate derivatives so the objective backpropagates through q_xx into every relevant model parameter. Enable coordinate autograd for validation even under an outer no_grad context; do not use inference_mode there. Handle truly constant/linear derivatives as zero without detaching nonzero parameter dependencies. The nu=0 path must delegate to the accepted core residual/loss and skip all second-derivative work.
physics_and_scaling.no_energy_or_entropy_guarantee: Momentum diffusion alone does not guarantee shallow-water mechanical-energy dissipation: its interior energy contribution is -nu*u_x*q_x = -nu*(h*u_x^2 + u*h_x*u_x), whose sign is not fixed. Do not claim entropy selection, positivity/conservation guarantees, unconditional stability or improved shock accuracy.

boundary_interpretation.unchanged_training_constraints: Retain the existing soft fixed-reservoir IC/BC penalties for both h and q at x=-5,+5. Continuity PDE samples remain interior; no new boundary derivative target is imposed.
boundary_interpretation.modified_problem_limit: These unchanged soft constraints define the controlled PINN regularization experiment. They do not establish a unique well-posed mixed hyperbolic/parabolic boundary-value problem; exact prescribed h and q at both ends together with continuity on the boundary can impose additional q_x restrictions. Do not describe the result as a validated exact viscous boundary solution.
boundary_interpretation.no_hidden_neumann_condition: Do not add q_x=0, a boundary layer penalty, a new boundary weight or a different reservoir rule to make the positive branch succeed; that would change another factor.
boundary_interpretation.finite_domain_limit: The inviscid analytical wave-boundary horizon remains relevant only to its comparison field. Positive diffusion has no strict finite propagation horizon, so it cannot prove that the modified branch has zero boundary influence at T=.5.

necessary_implementation_checks_proposed.scope: Only focused extension checks and the minimal directly affected core-interface comparison; no broad repeat of accepted suites or experiments.
necessary_implementation_checks_proposed.smooth_derivative_fixture: Use h*(x*,t*)=2+0.1*sin(x*) and q*(x*,t*)=a*x*^3+b*t*^2*x* with trainable a,b on a small deterministic scaled grid away from the IC discontinuity. Expected q*_(x*x*)=6a*x*, and the modified-minus-inviscid momentum residual is -6*nu_star*a*x*. Continuity is exactly unchanged. Verify the derivative of this residual difference with respect to a; this exposes a detached second-derivative parameter graph.
necessary_implementation_checks_proposed.scaling_fixture: At nonunit scales, verify the dimensional-residual identity and physical q_xx chain factors independently of the extension expression. Include zero/constant and linear-in-x q fixtures so valid zero second derivatives do not cause an autograd failure.
necessary_implementation_checks_proposed.nu_zero_equivalence: Using identical states/samples in CPU float32 and a small CPU float64 fixture, compare nu=0 versus core residual arrays, each complete PDE/IC/BC mean, weighted objective, every parameter gradient including absent-gradient patterns, one fresh Adam update, every parameter tensor and all optimizer moments/step counts. Exact equality is the intended delegation contract, not merely close gradient norms or equal total loss.
necessary_implementation_checks_proposed.chunk_check: If the frozen policy uses chunks, include one small nondivisible point-count fixture. Accumulate each chunk mean weighted by its actual point fraction, retain the sum-of-two-residual-squares PDE normalization, and update Adam only after the complete weighted objective. Match the accepted component/accumulation order; do not average chunk means or norms equally.
necessary_implementation_checks_proposed.invalid_result_handling: Reject nonfinite derivatives/objectives/gradients or nonpositive/nonfinite states with a retained failure receipt. No clipping, suppressed exception, automatic coefficient reduction or silent retry.

check_tolerances.nu_zero_delegation: exact tensor/gradient/optimizer equality in each dtype with identical inputs

necessary_implementation_checks_proposed.note: These are proposed software/derivative tolerances, not study error targets or proof of correctness over all states.

training_and_validation_reporting.training_PDE_mean: mean(r_h^2 + r_q_nu^2); IC/BC losses retain the same mean squared sum over nondimensional h,q. Fixed objective=PDE+10*IC+10*BC.
training_and_validation_reporting.physics_only: Strict fitting payload contains coordinates plus prescribed IC/BC targets only. No analytical interior values, final errors or sensor data enter the objective.
training_and_validation_reporting.selection: For each branch select the earliest strict minimum of its own fixed-weight modified-physics/IC/BC validation objective, including step0 and every update1..10000. At nu=0 that objective is the original inviscid objective. The positive branch's modified objective is part of the declared factor; its magnitude is not directly an accuracy ranking against the zero branch.
training_and_validation_reporting.validation_coordinates: Same fixed365 interior PDE,72 initial and10 boundary points from the predeclared baseline validation arrays. Preserve membership hashes and actual cast/scale precision.
training_and_validation_reporting.dual_reporting: On the positive branch log both modified PDE/total validation and original inviscid PDE/total validation at the same states/steps, with continuity and momentum residual summaries separated. Only the modified branch objective selects its checkpoint. At nu=0 its branch-modified and inviscid values are identical and need no second-derivative calculation.
training_and_validation_reporting.common_selected_checkpoint_diagnostic: At final selected checkpoints, evaluate both fixed operators gamma=0 and gamma=.001 on the same365 validation interior coordinates for both branches, saving r_h, r_q, q_xx and r_q_nu summaries/arrays. This supports cross-operator interpretation without requiring an unavailable counterfactual score history for a reused old control. These diagnostics cannot reselect either checkpoint.
training_and_validation_reporting.history_and_checkpoint_evidence: Save initial/latest/selected identities, actual update/validation counts, optimizer parameter membership/moments/counts, full histories, source/configuration/membership hashes and immutable run ancestry. Recompute strict-minimum selection from history and verify saved reloads before final analysis. Historical zero history begins at1 and remains untouched; its accepted step-zero-selection source qualification is retained rather than inventing a row.
training_and_validation_reporting.no_retuning: No further nu, seeds, budgets, point sets, precision, weights or checkpoint rules after final positive-branch accuracy. Retain both favorable and unfavorable field/residual tradeoffs.

analytical_comparison.reference: The unchanged inviscid wet E1 analytical solution evaluated pointwise at the common400 centres and50 positive times, as in the accepted core operator. Reuse its hash-verified saved outputs when axes/source match.
analytical_comparison.interpretation: Depth/discharge/velocity error measures how the trained modified-equation network approximates the selected inviscid target, including regularization smoothing/bias and optimization error. It is not error against an exact positive-viscosity solution.
analytical_comparison.discontinuity_limit: The inviscid analytical shock has distributional derivatives. Do not evaluate its piecewise classical q_xx while ignoring jump distributions and claim it solves r_q_nu=0.
analytical_comparison.paired_claims: Report the signed positive-minus-zero metric differences for this single predesignated seed, together with actual SI/relative errors and profiles. A reduced front error is a tested approximation tradeoff if observed; a reduced modified residual alone is insufficient. No generalization, convergence or guaranteed entropy/stability claim.

frozen_final_diagnostics_proposed.pointwise_fields: Same configs/evaluation.json400centres x= -5+(i+.5)*10/400 and50 times .01.. .50. Both PINNs and inviscid reference are pointwise at these coordinates; do not substitute the later friction study's cell-average operator.
frozen_final_diagnostics_proposed.errors: Per-time and pooled RMSE and relative L2 for h,q,u=q/h over whole, exact reference shock band +/- .1m and outside. Velocity uses the fixed h_ref>.001m mask with count/coverage. Preserve zero/near-zero norm and empty-region null+reason semantics with SI errors; do not choose a prediction-dependent mask.
frozen_final_diagnostics_proposed.front_profiles: Save complete h/q profiles at .10,.25,.50s from the existing final grid and reference shock position. Preserve all overshoot, displacement and smearing.
frozen_final_diagnostics_proposed.smoothing_diagnostic: From that same frozen grid/profile window, report maximum absolute adjacent-depth slope in the fixed exact-shock +/- .1m band. Also report10-to90percent transition width only where each of the fixed depth levels hR+.1*(hstar-hR) and hR+.9*(hstar-hR) has one ordered descending crossing in that window; use declared linear interpolation between existing samples. For absent/multiple/out-of-order crossings or a transition extending beyond the fixed window, use null plus reason and retain profiles/counts. The frozen inviscid hstar supplies levels; no fitted thresholds/window or extra model queries. These grid-dependent descriptors may reflect amplitude/position error as well as smoothing and cannot establish shock accuracy alone.
frozen_final_diagnostics_proposed.mass: Keep continuity's unchanged physical balance M(t)-5.5+integral_0^t(qR-qL)dt. Independent midpoint volume2000/4000cells includes t0 and all50 report times. Actual endpoint boundary trapezoid axes1001/2001include0,T and each report time exactly, using the accepted core protocol's node-replacement rule and saved axes.
frozen_final_diagnostics_proposed.mass_details: Report prescribed versus predicted initial volume/bias, signed and absolute corrected sampled extrema, final balance, additional bias-subtracted curve, separate left/right signed cumulative and absolute q-mismatch integrals, both h/q boundary mismatches and full raw arrays. Retain paired base/refined volume/flux/balance sensitivity as measured quadrature differences, not bounds or a convergence assertion.
frozen_final_diagnostics_proposed.provenance_and_partitions: Before pilot freeze training/validation/primary-final memberships, exact final/auxiliary axes and cast/scale behavior. Require primary final coordinates to remain disjoint from fitting/validation. Known IC/BC auxiliary conservation probes can repeat imposed boundary coordinates/times under the accepted core contract; identify them as auxiliary physics diagnostics, not independent held-out solution labels. Never silently filter or move the reused control's auxiliary axes. Both branches use the identical declared arrays.
frozen_final_diagnostics_proposed.momentum_budget_condition: If a later explicitly added momentum budget is reported, use P=integral q dx and flux Fq=q^2/h+g*h^2/2-nu*q_x at both physical endpoints, including its initial integral and actual time quadrature/refinement. q_x=(H Uc/Lc)q*_(x*). Save derivative/flux boundary arrays and added cost. Omitting -nu*q_x would falsely diagnose the modified equation; withhold that budget in the minimal plan rather than add unmeasured derivative-boundary work.

single_representative_pilot_proposed.start: Preserved common initial tensors and fresh Adam; never an accepted control's selected state. Full positive run later restarts from the same initial state and fresh optimizer, not the pilot checkpoint.
single_representative_pilot_proposed.workload: The full10000PDE/1000IC/500-per-side batch or exact frozen matched chunk policy; full second derivatives, parameter backward, Adam, all IC/BC components, initial plus every-update modified and inviscid validation, history append/flush, latest/selected checkpoint writes, terminal trusted reload and strict selection readback.
single_representative_pilot_proposed.precision_check: One fixed small CPU64 reference calculation at the initial tensor state, using exactly the same float32-representable weights and16 predetermined validation-interior points spread across all365indices (floor(k*364/15),k=0..15), cast to64. Compare residuals, q_xx, objective and every parameter gradient with CPU32, reporting absolute and norm-scaled discrepancies; do not compare only losses or use a cancellation-prone pure relative denominator. This is a small derivative/gradient fixture, not a float64 training run or performance benchmark. For its weighted objective/gradient comparison use those16PDE points plus the unchanged72validation IC and10BC points, keeping targets and1/10/10 weights identical across dtypes.
single_representative_pilot_proposed.precision_failure: Retain failure/discrepancies and withhold pilot acceptance pending a scoped graph/scaling/precision review. No silent float64 backend swap, extra coefficient, shortened full budget or unrecorded rerun. A changed pair requires a new pre-accuracy protocol; do not call an implementation/precision failure physical infeasibility.
single_representative_pilot_proposed.complete_query_and_output_workload: For the positive pilot, query/save all declared primary point fields20000coordinates, midpoint volumes306000coordinates and endpoint boundary6004coordinates:332004state-query coordinates plus the selected-checkpoint365-point dual-operator derivative diagnostic. Also perform one matched full query/derivative/output pass for the hash-bound historical zero selected checkpoint6512 under the new axes, without training it; preserve those zero arrays for exact later final reuse. Include both checkpoint loads, chunks, residual graph allocations, actual compressed NPZ/JSON/CSV I/O, hashing and reporting. Profile times are already in the primary grid and require no extra query.
single_representative_pilot_proposed.accuracy_exclusion: Pilot may save raw model states to measure actual query/I/O/storage workload, but does not compute, plot or inspect positive-vs-inviscid/zero errors, front widths or mass-quality summaries. Use fixed shape/reference-only diagnostic serialization fixtures where a final report workload must be timed. Physics-only validation logs remain visible for execution/selection; no final accuracy or quality may choose nu or other settings. Withhold the new zero-query error summaries until the final paired analysis as well; the coefficient and all settings are fixed independently of either new evaluation.
single_representative_pilot_proposed.conditional_control_cost: The completed historical-control audit supports one new positive full fit only, conditional on future nu=0 exact equivalence. Measure the new zero selected-checkpoint full query/output cost once during the bounded pilot and bind its arrays for later exact reuse. Its historical10000-update training cost remains a separate reused stage; do not add a second zero training pilot or fit.
single_representative_pilot_proposed.measurements: Actual25-update inclusive wall, component/second-derivative backward/validation/checkpoint/history costs, trusted reload, each complete query/integration/I/O/hash stage, written bytes, process lifetime RSS and contemporaneous host load/precision/thread/library information. Peak RSS is not free memory, instantaneous pressure or a sustained thermal guarantee.
single_representative_pilot_proposed.full_cost_projection: Report positive per-step mean/median/range times10000 and inclusive25-update training-wall scaling with their exact scopes. Add measured setup/reload, positive full final diagnostics/queries/I/O and the single new historical-control full evaluation, reference reuse/loading and storage/hash costs. Separate already performed pilot costs, historical zero training, and any later fresh positive evaluation so no stage is double-counted. Figure/archive/extraction/replay costs remain separately unmeasured until observed. No invented runtime, confidence bound, device ordering or workload-matched speedup.
single_representative_pilot_proposed.not_a_new_benchmark: One representative feasibility observation, without repeated fits to obtain a favorable cost. A short pilot does not measure full-run thermal behavior, trained-field compression or selected-checkpoint write frequency.

proposed_release_decision.gate_prerequisites: Bind the completed historical-control audit and its explicit immutable inputs/unchanged shared scientific sources; future viscosity nu=0 equivalence must still pass. Freeze all one-factor/sample/initialization/validation/evaluation contracts and no-chunk arithmetic; record focused sign/scaling/second-derivative/zero-limit/all-gradient/one-update checks and the single25-update representative precision/cost pilot, preserving failures.
proposed_release_decision.continuation: If implementation/precision evidence is valid and measured complete new workload is acceptable for the recorded resources/budget, root may explicitly release exactly one new positive-nu full fit with the conditionally reused historical zero control. This file supplies no resource budget or release and proposes no new zero full fit.
proposed_release_decision.no_accuracy_gate: A favorable pilot/final approximation error is not a release condition. Do not require a prechosen accuracy gain, conservation threshold or paper-quality result; a completed unfavorable one-factor result is useful.
proposed_release_decision.failure_outcome: A valid but costly or failed precision/resource pilot can complete a bounded feasibility finding while the full comparison remains unexecuted. Distinguish incomplete implementation, resource evidence and scientific unfavorable results; do not erase failures or mark all Phase11 complete.
proposed_release_decision.next_after_actual_full_outputs: Bounded independent saved-array error/residual/front/mass/boundary/cost readback, with selected-checkpoint/source/membership hashes, then a few saved-data figures and preserved executable/replay evidence. No new seed/coefficient or accuracy-driven retuning.
